name: OpenHouse Household Models V4
deduplication: V1-V3 IDs, normalized Poly Haven IDs/titles, original-only Innerscene provenance; SHA-256 uniqueness within V4. No third-party Poly Haven mirrors included.
quality_gate: No low-poly tags; at least 10000 source triangles; decoded real previews; visual selection recorded in catalog. Triangle count alone does not establish photorealism.
limits: Structural validation and provider-thumbnail review; no Blender render/import test. Geometry and materials remain unmodified; Poly Haven glTF dependencies are embedded into GLB. Nominal source dimensions are not a building survey.

source_audit.status: 32 household food scans downloaded as HQ-2K-JPG; 2 nature models excluded. API type filter returned other types; inspected all 2908 catalog records and filtered actual dataType=3DModel.

Public sitemap and original-model CC0 metadata inspected; 3.2 second serial request spacing. Low-poly, mirrors of Poly Haven/Kenney, CAD and irrelevant items excluded. Candidate files are validated before inclusion. HTTP 403 catalog query routes were not bypassed; HTTP 429 requires backoff. Ten flower/decor/food assets were also rejected after thumbnail review as visibly simplified/stylized despite passing the triangle threshold.

20 new original models downloaded from official glTF 2K URLs with source size and MD5 checks. V1-V3 normalized IDs and titles excluded. Dependencies embedded into GLB without geometry/material changes; original file SHA-256 evidence recorded. An unidentified request returned 403; the ordinary identified public API request and actual file downloads returned 200 without authentication. No third-party mirrors used.
Excluded: current custom license prohibits collection redistribution and automated downloads without written permission.
